note: THE DECISION INDEX EVERY SESSION IS TOLD TO GREP IS 21 PERCENT INCOMPLETE, AND NOTHING CHECKS IT. Found by The Pavement, 2026-09-01, while resolving a docs/decisions/README.md merge conflict. MEASURED, not inferred: 287 decision files exist under docs/decisions/; docs/decisions/README.md indexes 226 of them. 61 are missing. origin/main is missing EXACTLY THE SAME 61, so no campaign branch caused it and absorbing main does not fix it. THE GENERATED HALF IS FINE and that is what makes this quiet: docs/digest/decisions-in-force.md carries 278 and correctly omits 9, all of which really are Status Superseded (verified one by one, including 0141 superseded by 0506). So a session that reads the digest gets a correct answer and a session that opens the README sees a healthy-looking table missing a fifth of the tree. WHY IT MATTERS: root CLAUDE.md tells you to consult docs/decisions/ before relitigating an architectural question, and grep before minting a decision number. The README is the human entry point to that tree. A decision you cannot find reads as a decision nobody made. WHAT WOULD CATCH IT: a cli/tests/suite/docs_consistency.rs check asserting every 0NNN-*.md file under docs/decisions/ has a row in README.md. That file already runs eight families of docs invariant in the gate phase and already has decision_numbers_are_unique, so the machinery is there and the missing check is one direction of an existing one. NOT FIXED BY US: an absorption is the wrong commit to widen, and this is a repo-wide docs gate rather than campaign work. Parked in docs/superpowers/ledgers/2026-08-30-the-pavement.md under deferred minors, with the numbers, so whoever picks it up does not have to re-measure.
